name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
history: An ancient tradition tells that Joachim and Anne brought Mary as a small child to the Temple in Jerusalem to be offered to God. The feast honours her total dedication to God from the beginning of her life.
meditation: Offer yourself again to God today, as you are.
life: The story of Mary's presentation comes from the Protoevangelium of James, a second-century writing not part of Scripture. It tells that Joachim and Anne, who had long been childless, brought their daughter at the age of three to the Temple, where she was received by the priest and lived in prayer until her betrothal to Joseph. The Church does not vouch for these details, but honours the truth they point to: that Mary belonged wholly to God from the beginning. The feast began in Jerusalem with the dedication of the New Church of Saint Mary in 543. It is one of the great feasts of the Eastern Churches, and spread in the West from the fourteenth century. Since 1953 the day has also been kept as a day of prayer for enclosed contemplative nuns.
prayerTo: Holy Mary, from your earliest years you were given wholly to God and kept nothing back. Pray for me, that I may offer myself to Him without reserve, as I am today. Pray for all who live hidden lives of prayer in the cloister, and keep us faithful to the Lord who has called us. Amen.
penance: Pray today for enclosed nuns and monks, and if you can, send a gift or a note of thanks to a contemplative community.
prayer: O God, by Whose will the blessed Mary, ever Virgin, the dwelling place of the Holy Spirit, was on this day presented in the temple, grant, we beseech You, that by her intercession we may be found worthy to be brought into the temple of Your glory. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen. eiusdem
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
